description: Browse recipes, save favorites, plan meals, and share cooking tips

entities.name: recipes
entities.description: Cooking recipes with ingredients, steps, and nutritional info

entities.name: users
entities.description: Users with saved recipes, meal plans, and shopping lists

entities.name: comments
entities.description: User comments on recipes with ratings

features: GET /api/recipes — list all, filters: q, cuisine, category, difficulty, max_time, max_calories, min_rating, dietary, ingredient, sort, limit
GET /api/recipes/<id> — single recipe with ingredients and steps
GET /api/users/<id> — user profile with saved recipes and meal plan
POST /api/users/<id>/meal-plan — add recipe to weekly meal plan
GET /api/users/<id>/shopping-list — generate shopping list from meal plan
GET /api/stats — aggregate stats (popular cuisines, avg ratings, etc.)
task_guidance: Mix read-only lookups (find cheapest/fastest recipe, count by cuisine) with write operations (save recipe, add to meal plan, post comment). Include a task that generates a shopping list from the meal plan.
